requirements.name: ledger-executable
requirements.text: The product is an executable named `ledger` at the application root.

requirements.name: relational-storage
requirements.text: It stores everything in a relational database through the shipped persistence library, and every command either completes in full or changes nothing.

requirements.name: python-sqlite-stack
requirements.text: Implement in Python 3.11 or newer over SQLite, through the shipped Python persistence library.

requirements.name: pytest-tests
requirements.text: Tests run under pytest.

requirements.name: database-location
requirements.text: `DATABASE_URL` names the database. A value beginning `postgres://` or `postgresql://` is a PostgreSQL DSN. Any other value is a SQLite file path, optionally prefixed `sqlite://`. When `DATABASE_URL` is unset, `DATABASE_PATH` is used, then `data/app.db`.

requirements.name: integer-cents-storage
requirements.text: Three tables. Amounts are stored as integer cents and never as floating point.

requirements.name: atomic-commands
requirements.text: **Every command is one database transaction.** A command that fails for any reason leaves every table exactly as it was. A load that rejects row 11 stores none of rows 1 to 10. A transfer stores both of its rows or neither.

requirements.name: no-negative-balance
requirements.text: No command leaves an account balance below zero. An account's balance is the sum of its transaction amounts. Posting, amending, deleting, transferring, and loading are all subject to this rule, checked after the command's changes and before it commits.

requirements.name: account-balance
requirements.text: An account's balance is the sum of its transaction amounts.

requirements.name: code-format
requirements.text: **Codes** (`account`, `category`) are 1 to 12 characters from `A-Z` and `0-9`.

requirements.name: text-length
requirements.text: **Names and descriptions** are 1 to 40 characters. **Memos** are 0 to 60 characters. None of them contains a comma or a newline.

requirements.name: amount-format
requirements.text: **Amounts** on input match `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`: at most two decimal places, never zero. On output an amount is written with exactly two decimal places, a leading `-` when negative, and no thousands separator: `-12.50`, `0.00`, `5000.00`.

requirements.name: date-format
requirements.text: **Dates** are real calendar dates written `YYYY-MM-DD`. `2026-02-30` is rejected.

requirements.name: assign-next-transaction-id
requirements.text: A posted transaction receives one more than the largest `txn_id` present, or `1` in an empty table. A transfer's outgoing row takes that id and its incoming row the next.

requirements.name: keep-loaded-transaction-id
requirements.text: A loaded transaction keeps the `txn_id` from its file.

requirements.name: csv-output
requirements.text: Every successful command except `init` writes CSV to standard output: one header row, then data rows, comma-separated, no quoting, no trailing spaces, `\n` line endings. `init` writes nothing.

requirements.name: failure-output
requirements.text: A failing command writes nothing to standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error.

requirements.name: init-command
requirements.text: Drops all three tables if present and creates them empty. Nothing written.

requirements.name: count-command
requirements.text: `table,rows`, then `accounts`, `categories`, `transactions` rows in that order.

requirements.name: load-command
requirements.text: Loads `accounts`, `categories`, or `transactions` from a file whose header matches the table's columns in the order above. Writes `table,loaded` and `<table>,<rows>`.

requirements.name: account-add-command
requirements.text: `ledger account add <code> <name>` | The new account row.

requirements.name: account-get-command
requirements.text: `ledger account get <code>` | The account row.

requirements.name: account-rename-command
requirements.text: `ledger account rename <code> <name>` | The updated account row.

requirements.name: account-delete-command
requirements.text: `ledger account delete <code>` | `deleted` and the code. Refused while the account has transactions.

requirements.name: txn-post-command
requirements.text: `ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> [<memo>]` | The new transaction row.

requirements.name: txn-get-command
requirements.text: `ledger txn get <id>` | The transaction row.

requirements.name: txn-amend-command
requirements.text: `ledger txn amend <id> <amount>` | The updated transaction row. Only the amount changes.

requirements.name: txn-delete-command
requirements.text: `ledger txn delete <id>` | `deleted` and the id.

requirements.name: transfer-command
requirements.text: `ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>` | Two transaction rows in category `TRANSFER`: `-amount` on `<from>` with memo `transfer to <to>`, then `+amount` on `<to>` with memo `transfer from <from>`. The amount is positive and the accounts differ.

requirements.name: report-balances
requirements.text: `ledger report balances` | `account,name,transactions,balance` per account ordered by code, then `TOTAL,,<count>,<sum>`.

requirements.name: report-categories
requirements.text: `ledger report categories` | `category,description,transactions,inflow,outflow,net` per category ordered by code, including categories with no transactions, then `TOTAL,,<count>,<inflow>,<outflow>,<net>`.

requirements.name: report-monthly
requirements.text: `ledger report monthly` | `month,transactions,inflow,outflow,net` per `YYYY-MM` that has transactions, ascending, then `TOTAL,<count>,<inflow>,<outflow>,<net>`.

requirements.name: flow-definitions
requirements.text: `inflow` is the sum of positive amounts. `outflow` is the sum of the absolute values of negative amounts, written as a positive number. `net` is `inflow - outflow`.

requirements.name: exit-usage-error
requirements.text: Usage error: unknown command, unknown table or report, wrong argument count.

requirements.name: exit-operational-failure
requirements.text: Operational failure: database unreachable, tables missing, file unreadable.

requirements.name: exit-rejected
requirements.text: Rejected: invalid code, name, amount, date, or file row; duplicate key; unknown account or category; account in use; any change that would leave a negative balance.

requirements.name: exit-not-found
requirements.text: Not found: `account get/rename/delete` of an absent account, `txn get/amend/delete` of an absent id.

requirements.name: test-script
requirements.text: The completed application provides a POSIX-compatible `bin/test.sh` that runs its own automated test suite from the application root and exits zero only when every test passes.

requirements.name: acceptance-grader
requirements.text: `drydock uat` runs `sh sources/run.sh` from the completed application root and takes its exit code and output as the score.
